title: Return Manifest Contract
description: Machine-checkable shape for what a dispatched subagent returns to the conductor. Unlike brief/crew-plan/verdict, this contract has no single pre-existing doctrine .md file of its own — it is a NEW contract that ULTIMATE_FRAMEWORK_PLAN.md introduces at §A.2/§C1/§D3 ('return-manifest.schema.json (artifact paths + claims-with-evidence + status)'), operationalizing principles already stated across three doctrine files: conductor/orchestra-model.md §4c ('the conductor reads the returned PRIMARY artifact, never trusts the summary'); conductor/dispatch-brief.md field 3's evidence requirement ('every factual claim... must be grounded in a primary artifact... inference must be labeled as inference'); and conductor/subagent-failure-protocol.md's five failure states (empty/partial/degraded/timeout/error). Phase 0 / Design Decision #3: 'A schema-miss is auto-classified as degraded output -> enters the retry loop with a changed brief. The weak agent's most dangerous move (sounding finished) becomes mechanically impossible to cash.'

task_id.description: Matches the crew-plan task id this return answers.

mission_id.description: Ties to the mission-states.md FSM record.

agent.description: Which dispatchable agent produced this return.

status.description: subagent-failure-protocol.md's five failure states (partial, degraded, error, empty, timeout) plus 'complete' as the success complement not itself named in the failure table.

self_reported_complete.description: The agent's own completion claim, captured SEPARATELY from the mechanically-derived `status` field. ULTIMATE_FRAMEWORK_PLAN.md §A.2: 'a weak model's I've completed the analysis costs nothing to say' — keeping the two fields distinct lets a gate flag the case where self_reported_complete:true but status is not 'complete'.

artifacts.description: Contracted-path artifacts the conductor reads itself. 'Existence and shape are model-independent checks' (ULTIMATE_FRAMEWORK_PLAN.md §A.2).

claims.description: Every factual claim the return makes, each carrying an evidence pointer or an explicit inferred:true label (dispatch-brief.md field 3's evidence requirement, applied to the return side of the contract).

flags.description: Escalation triggers hit, NOT-responsible-for boundary items skipped, blockers encountered.

then.$comment: A return claiming any real output (complete/partial/degraded) must point at least one artifact the conductor can read itself. An empty artifacts[] on a non-empty/non-error status is itself a schema-miss — 'a file that must exist at a contracted path either exists or doesn't' (ULTIMATE_FRAMEWORK_PLAN.md §A.2).

evidence.description: The primary artifact (file path, URL, log endpoint, or quoted tool output) the claim traces to.

inferred.description: dispatch-brief.md field 3: 'inference must be labeled as inference.'

then.$comment: A claim not labeled as inference must carry a non-empty evidence pointer — dispatch-brief.md: 'a claim with no artifact pointer is rejected on sight' (ULTIMATE_FRAMEWORK_PLAN.md §A.1).

$comment: Minimal-validator keyword subset supported by tessctl validate: type, enum, const, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, minItems, maxItems, minLength, maxLength, pattern, minimum, maximum, exclusiveMinimum, exclusiveMaximum, if/then/else, oneOf, anyOf, allOf, contains, $ref, $defs.
